rows.grounds: qualifies the nectar as the true being of Kaula
further qualifies the nectar as consisting in the art of desire

items.question: What essential nature characterizes the Kaula nectar that is to be heard?
premises: The nectar is identified as the true nature of Kaula.
This nectar consists in the essence of kāmakalā.
The listener is directly commanded to hear about this nectar.
items.inference: The Kaula nectar to be heard is the true Kaula reality whose essence is kāmakalā.
uncertainties: The precise doctrinal sense of kāmakalā in this context is not fully specified by the verse alone.
items.plain_english: Hear of the nectar, the true nature of Kaula, whose essence is the art of desire.
